name: Birdie Package (2 hours)
description: 2-hour mobile golf simulator package. Setup and teardown included. All golf games.

name: Eagle Package (4 hours)
description: 4-hour mobile golf simulator package. Setup and teardown included. All games, Feral Package eligible.

name: Champion Package (6 hours)
description: 6-hour mobile golf simulator package. Setup and teardown included. All games, Feral Package eligible.

name: All Day Package (8 hours)
description: Full-day mobile golf simulator package. Setup and teardown included. All games, Feral Package eligible.

name: Corporate Package (custom)
description: Customized corporate event. Starting price; final amount per quote.

name: Feral Experience Add-On
description: Adds 14+ non-golf simulator games to any golf package. Flat rate.

name: Additional Hour
description: Each additional hour of simulator time beyond the package.

name: Speaker / Music Add-On
description: Speaker and music for the event.

name: Generator Add-On
description: Generator when venue power is not available.

name: Travel Fee (51-100 miles)
description: Flat travel fee for venues 51 to 100 miles from Denham Springs. Within 50 miles is included; beyond 100 miles is quoted.
